input.content:
STAGE: scope/compliance check of the three candidates against the frozen packs (b528ff7b5e6bf6c3 BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ, 4655c2de358ffdc8 BRad-RQ, f36cdf069f009a9b TSG-SID).
READ: the three inline evidence bundles (identical observed blocks E5-E11, differing PROPOSED blocks E1-E3/E12-E13) plus the three proposal texts; no other files are readable in this workspace (running.json/progress.jsonl are permission-denied), so all grounding is the frozen bundle.
OBSERVED: all three pass BEHAVIOUR (successor entropy / predecessor-context entropy / top-M successor table, training-split only, E3 no-leak claims) and HYPERBOLIC GEOMETRY (Mobius residual with per-item c_i; exp_0 radius map at fixed c=1; log/parallel transport at c_l=1/(4 s_l^2)). Coupling is real in all three: behaviour enters the same expression the geometry evaluates (c_i in exp/Mobius/distance; r_i in the tangent target that is exp-mapped and scored; v_b inside the transported STE gradient).
DIFFERENCES: TSG-SID is the only proposal that explicitly names both switches (USE_BEHAV, USE_HYPER) and derives every constant from measured quantities (s_l, delta_l, mean|v_b|) with an explicit safeguard (tanh bound to r_l, commit-distance gate kappa). BRANCHCURV names both switch-off settings only in the hypothesis, leaves the scale factor M_l undefined in its equations, and uses the largest cost (~5%). BRad-RQ names no behaviour-off/geometry-off switch at all and replaces encoder magnitude outright, which is the biggest change to the reconstruction target.
OPEN: which candidate the observed failure patterns (E6/E7/E8/E11) favour.

STAGE: evidence-based placement using E6/E7 beam survival and teacher-forced NLL, E5 signal strength, E8 level-1 capacity ceiling, E11 first-prefix diagnostic.
READ: E6 recall table (l1_br 0.04671; l1_br_euclid 0.06207; l1_only 0.06233; resample 0.06363; successor_entropy 0.05122; successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500; successor_geodesic_coarse_v2 0.05463; tangent_successor_residual 0.05500), E7 per-position NLL (l1_br 0/0/0/9.03; tangent_successor_residual 4.00/3.17/1.67/0.29; resample 4.55/3.82/0.73/0.05), E8 K-sweep co-location (K=256 positive 0.0822 vs negative 0.0129), E11 same_first_prefix_rate 0.0907 vs permuted null 0.067.
OBSERVED: every geometry-in-quantizer variant in the bundle sits below the Euclidean baselines and below the 0.065 target; best observed is a non-geometric resample at 0.06363. Two distinct failure signatures: (a) prefix collapse when the coarse prefix is made behaviour-predictable - l1_br has gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000/0.068 and NLL 0/0/0/9.03 yet recall 0.04671, while its own Euclidean counterpart l1_br_euclid reaches 0.06207 and l1_only 0.06233, i.e. the hyperbolic treatment of a level-1 behaviour token cost ~0.015 absolute; (b) graded-but-weaker prefix profiles for successor-geometry variants - successor_geodesic_coarse/_v2 0.05500/0.05463 and tangent_successor_residual 0.05500, with tangent_successor_residual keeping the healthy graded profile 4.00/3.17/1.67/0.29 and non-collapsed survival 0.643/0.180/0.090/0.073.
REASONING: BRad-RQ reproduces signature (a) by construction (level-1 prefix locked to a rank of behaviour entropy at fixed c=1, with the 1/((1-|a|^2)(1-|e|^2)) factor forcing radial dominance), and the bundle shows that design's geometry-off arm beating its geometry-on arm 0.06207 vs 0.04671; it also discards encoder magnitude and names no switches, so it is placed last. BRANCHCURV has the strongest measured signal (E5 top-1 mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973, 5-bin spread) and a genuinely new locus (the residual chain), but its nearest evidence is the 0.055 geodesic-coarse family and a per-item metric makes codeword meaning item-dependent while E8/E11 show level-1 behavioural structure is already thin (0.0822 vs 0.0129 co-location; 0.0907 vs 0.067 first-prefix), plus M_l is undefined: placed second. TSG-SID lands in signature (b), the least destructive family in E7 (no collapse, graded NLL), and is the only fully switch-explicit, fully measured-constant spec, so it is placed first even though its analogue recall 0.05500 is a known 0.007 regression from Euclidean.
CORRECTION/NOTE: none of the three is supported by positive evidence above 0.065; placement is by least expected damage and by spec completeness, and I say so in each reason.
OPEN: nothing further; final answer recorded next.

STAGE: final answer handed in (ranking of the three proposals).
READ: the frozen bundles b528ff7b5e6bf6c3, 4655c2de358ffdc8, f36cdf069f009a9b; evidence used is E5 (successor-entropy stratification), E6 (width-20 beam recall table), E7 (per-position teacher-forced NLL), E8 (level-1 capacity ceiling K sweep), E11 (first-prefix diagnostic), and the PROPOSED scope blocks E1-E3/E12-E13.
OBSERVED/ANSWER:
RANK: TSG-SID | position=1
RANK: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ | position=2
RANK: BRad-RQ | position=3
Placement logic: all three are in scope and computationally coupled, but no observed arm reaches the 0.065 target (best observed is a non-geometric resample at 0.06363 and every geometric variant is 0.047-0.062), so placement is by least expected damage to prefix structure plus spec completeness. TSG-SID first: its analogue keeps a graded, non-collapsed prefix profile in E7 and it is the only fully switch-explicit, fully measured-constant spec. BRANCHCURV second: strongest signal in E5 but its nearest evidence is the 0.055 geodesic-coarse family, per-item curvature breaks shared-codeword comparability, and M_l is undefined. BRad-RQ last: its level-1 behaviour-rank design is the l1_br family, where geometry-on 0.04671 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000 and NLL 0/0/0/9.03 is decisively worse than the same mechanism with geometry off (0.06207/0.06233), and it discards encoder magnitude and names no switches.
OPEN: nothing; this record supersedes nothing and is the complete answer.

part.text:
RANK: TSG-SID | position=1 | reason=E7's tangent_successor_residual is its closest analogue and keeps the healthiest prefix profile (T1..T4 NLL 4.00/3.17/1.67/0.29, gold prefix alive 0.643/0.180/0.090/0.073) with no l1_br-style collapse, and it is the only candidate naming both switches (USE_BEHAV/USE_HYPER) with every constant measured from s_l, delta_l, mean|v_b| under the no-tuning policy, though its analogue recall 0.05500 vs l1_br_euclid 0.06207 is a known 0.007 regression.
RANK: BRANCHCURV-MOEB-RQ | position=2 | reason=E5 gives the strongest measured behaviour range (top-1 successor mass 0.4375 vs 0.0543, Spearman -0.973, distinct successors 2.72 to 41.41) and the cap-free c_i in [1e-3,c_max] spans exactly that range, but the nearest evidence is successor_geodesic_coarse/_v2 at 0.05500/0.05463 against 0.06207 Euclidean, E8/E11 show level-1 behavioural structure is already thin (0.0822 vs 0.0129 co-location; 0.0907 vs 0.067 first-prefix), and per-item curvature makes shared-codeword meaning item-dependent while M_l is left undefined.
RANK: BRad-RQ | position=3 | reason=the bundle carries the clearest negative for exactly this design: the level-1 behaviour-ranked prefix with its geometry off scores l1_br_euclid 0.06207 / l1_only 0.06233 but with geometry on l1_br falls to 0.04671 with gold prefix alive 1.000/1.000/1.000 and NLL 0/0/0/9.03, i.e. a trivially predictable, uninformative prefix, and the proposal additionally discards encoder magnitude and E8 caps level-1 co-location at 0.0822 for K=256 while naming no behaviour-off/geometry-off switches.
